description: Check real-time slot availability for baby scans on a specific date in Pretoria. Returns trading status, booked times, and open morning/afternoon appointment slots. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'check_booking_availability' on Bump to Baby Store (bumptobabysa.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_studio_info' or 'get_scan_packages_and_pricing' or 'get_gestational_guide' for their respective operations). Parameters: date (required), service_type (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

date.description: Target appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-09-12"). Required.

service_type.description: Desired service (e.g. "4D Scan", "Gender Scan", "2D Scan"). Optional.

name: check_booking_availability
title: Check Booking Availability
